notes.title: Breakout Beyond Patch Notes For June 18, 2025
notes.notes: [p]In addition to minor bug fixes as well as adding an option to change which input axis is read for mouse/joystick, today’s update introduces the ability to select your display orientation for some vertical brick breaking![/p][p][/p][p]To change your display orientation, navigate to OPTIONS, go to Layout, then change Screen to Vertical. Rotate your display and enjoy![/p][p][/p][p]You may see people calling this TATE mode! TATE (pronounced tah-tay) is a Japanese term referring to arcade games with vertically oriented screens, usually seen in vertical scrolling shoot-em-ups. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for continuing to enjoy Breakout Beyond![/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - Patch Notes for 4/11/2025
notes.notes:
This patch addresses the following:

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where "Blast from the Past" achievement wouldn't unlock under certain conditions
[*] Fixes Infinite mode not being infinite
[*] Added D-Pad controls
[*] Added new leaderboard for Voyage mode
[*] Added Quality of Life improvements to level select screen
[*] Additional bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Let's Play Breakout Beyond w/ Choice Provisions
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=FIpXAS0IEnY;full][/previewyoutube]
After much teasing, we're back with some game announcements and, in turn, some previews with the devs! Breakout Beyond has taken a fascinating journey leading up to its release - starting as an ill-fated Amico title before finding a second life under Atari publishing. We get into all of that and more in this episode thanks to my guests: Garrett Varrin (Programmer / Systems Designer at Choice Provisions), Mike Roush (Cofounder of Choice Provisions), and Jason Cirillo (Engineer/Designer at Digital Eclipse).

notes.title: Atari announced Breakout Beyond, a fresh spin on the classic from the devs of BIT.TRIP
notes.notes:
The Breakout franchise is making a full return, with Atari announcing Breakout Beyond, developed by Choice Provisions (the studio behind BIT.TRIP).

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/02/atari-announced-breakout-beyond-a-fresh-spin-on-the-classic-from-the-devs-of-bit-trip/
